OpenAI Codex App Server component

Version: 0.151.0
Platform: aarch64-apple-darwin (Apple Silicon)
Official release tag: rust-v0.151.0
Official asset: https://github.com/openai/codex/releases/download/rust-v0.151.0/codex-app-server-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz
SHA-256: 09193ef452f35d3558ac5bef21e14d6e3c9763edaa36e6c614126a15fca0ff57
License: https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/main/LICENSE

The archive is not committed to this repository. The build script downloads the official asset directly from OpenAI's GitHub release and verifies the SHA-256 before embedding the standalone app server in the built app.
